limits: Desktop Chrome with viewport emulation, not a physical mobile-device test.
Readback/worker timings sample the latest result, not capture-to-command latency.
Main-thread JS heap grows in both Carry and sensor-free control; root cause, VRAM and multi-hour stability unverified.
Preview interaction assertions pass; console gate fails on Vercel feedback.js injection blocked by unchanged CSP.
Short curved clips have weak aligned orientation despite conditioned positional ATE; no global localization claim.
